translation: The viscera, bowels, sinews, and skin receive qi and blood, mutually giving birth and nourishing, with benefit and no obstruction, each completing its own original form. But when it reaches accumulation, it is like iron producing rust, attaching to the bones, flesh, viscera, and bowels to grow, dividing qi, blood, sinews, and membranes to form. At first it is as thin as a thread, with growth and no dispersal; and when it reaches its extreme, it is drawn day by day and grows month by month, becoming thick with the years and large with the seasons. Not only is all the qi and blood seized by it, but even the positions are invaded by it, the empty orifices are filled, the hundred diseases arise in clusters, and the person instead has no way to complete himself. Nourishing an abscess into a calamity, who bears the blame? Now having obtained this rubbing method, the accumulation can be dispersed at once, and disease will never arise; truly it is the art of raising the dead and restoring life, and it is fitting that it be the method of nourishing the form.
